name: print-social-carousel-magenta-possibilities-cover-focus
title: Magenta 'World of Possibilities' carousel with dominant cover tile
whatItIs: A third framing of the same magenta carousel system, with the cover tile enlarged relative to the grid to foreground the product render and headline stack more prominently.
whatItMeans: Presenting the cover tile at a larger relative scale in marketing shots for the template pack itself helps a potential buyer judge the hero tile's impact before purchasing.
techniques: enlarge the cover/hero tile relative to supporting tiles when presenting a template pack for sale
stack multiple short headline phrases vertically on a cover tile to build a rhythm before the CTA

vocabulary.definition: the dominant, usually largest tile in a grid or carousel meant to capture initial attention
